title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 6 — WORLD 9: B2 ADVANCED INDEPENDENCE

targets.vocabulary: 2200+ active vocabulary with advanced collocations, idioms, phrasal verbs, academic and professional expressions
targets.reading: 1400–1600 words with inference, evaluation, synthesis and source comparison
targets.listening: 14–16 minutes of natural multi-speaker input with varied accents and viewpoints
targets.speaking: 18–22 minute sustained independent interaction, debate, negotiation and presentation
targets.writing: 450–550 words with structured argument, synthesis and formal register
targets.presentation: 10–12 minutes with evidence, signposting and audience interaction

grammar: advanced tense and aspect in complex discourse
future in the past and perspective shifts
advanced relative clauses and complex noun phrases
ellipsis and substitution in natural discourse

missions.title: Advanced Vocabulary Intelligence Lab
missions.focus: Build independent command of advanced vocabulary through collocations, idioms, phrasal verbs, word families and contextual precision.

missions.title: Perspective & Time Control
missions.focus: Shift accurately between past, present and future viewpoints while maintaining clear sequence and meaning in extended communication.

missions.title: Speculation & Evidence Lab
missions.focus: Use modal perfects and evidence-based language to distinguish certainty, probability, possibility and inference.

missions.title: Complex Conditional Strategy
missions.focus: Analyze hypothetical chains, alternative histories and future consequences using mixed and extended conditional structures.

missions.title: Reporting & Stance Control
missions.focus: Report information while controlling certainty, distance, attribution and personal stance through advanced reporting structures.

missions.title: Complex Sentence Engineering
missions.focus: Construct sophisticated sentences using participle clauses, reduced relatives, noun-phrase expansion and information compression.

missions.title: Information Focus & Emphasis
missions.focus: Manipulate sentence structure with inversion, fronting and cleft constructions to highlight key information naturally.

missions.title: Natural Discourse Mastery
missions.focus: Use ellipsis, substitution, referencing and discourse markers to make extended communication concise, cohesive and natural.

missions.title: Pragmatics & Register Mission
missions.focus: Select language appropriate to relationship, purpose, power, context and degree of formality while remaining diplomatic.

missions.title: Independent B2 Discussion Arena
missions.focus: Lead a sustained discussion by introducing topics, developing ideas, challenging claims, clarifying meaning and summarizing outcomes.

missions.title: Reading Mastery — Compare & Evaluate Sources
missions.focus: Compare perspectives across extended texts, identify evidence quality, detect assumptions and synthesize key information.

missions.title: Listening Mastery — Voices & Viewpoints
missions.focus: Follow natural discussions with interruptions, implied meaning, changing attitudes, disagreement and multiple viewpoints.

missions.title: B2+ Evidence-Based Essay
missions.focus: Write a 450–550 word structured argument that integrates evidence, concession, counterargument, rebuttal and conclusion.

missions.title: Independent Report & Action Plan
missions.focus: Analyze a complex scenario, summarize findings and produce a formal action plan with justified recommendations.

missions.title: Executive Presentation Challenge
missions.focus: Deliver a 10–12 minute evidence-based presentation with clear signposting, comparison, persuasion and audience questions.

missions.title: AI, Media & Society Investigation
missions.focus: Explore AI, misinformation, digital privacy, media influence and social change through evidence-based discussion and writing.

missions.title: Global Travel & Public Services Mission
missions.focus: Independently solve complex travel, accommodation, transport and public-service situations through clarification and negotiation.

missions.title: High-Stakes Negotiation Simulation
missions.focus: Manage disagreement, priorities and competing interests while proposing solutions, making concessions and reaching agreement.

missions.title: B2+ Independence Marathon
missions.focus: Complete a connected multi-stage challenge requiring source analysis, listening, spontaneous interaction, formal writing and presentation.

missions.title: WORLD 9 MASTER QUEST — B2 ADVANCED INDEPENDENCE
missions.focus: Complete a fully independent real-world mission by analyzing information, making decisions, defending a position, negotiating and presenting a final solution.

assessment: advanced B2 grammar range and flexibility
independent vocabulary selection and collocation control
sustained fluency with effective interaction strategies
understanding of explicit, implied and speaker-attitude meaning
comparison and synthesis of information from sources
